affected_targets.heading: ## Transport Host vs Upstream Provider Separation

exact_missing_items: Models_System.md conflates transport host identity (the server/endpoint serving the model) with upstream provider identity (the commercial provider whose model is being called)
These are different identity axes: transport host is infrastructure; upstream provider is commercial relationship
Identity attribution for usage, billing, rate limiting, and permission scoping must separate these two axes
A request may go through a locally-hosted transport proxy but the upstream provider identity is still an external commercial entity
account-health / pressure event family: account_health_event must carry at minimum: account_id, health_kind, health_level, threshold_crossed?, details
account_pressure_episode must be queryable from any surface that shows account health trends
Models_System.md must also have an account-health display section for model-provider account degradation
transport/upstream provider split in Models_System.md must be completed: add transport_host_id and upstream_provider_id as distinct identity fields in model configuration and in usage records
A model_routing_record must carry both fields so that locally proxied calls are attributed to the correct upstream commercial provider
Models_System.md account-health display for model-provider account degradation must reference upstream_provider_id, not transport host
